test_title: PYST 49: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Renewable energy / sources like solar and wind power / will replaced traditional fossil fuels / and help reduce carbon emissions.

options.text: sources like solar and wind power

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form** "replaced" **used in place of **"replace".**
 
• The correct future tense form should be **"will replace" instead of "will replaced".**
 
• This** ensures** grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Renewable energy sources like solar and wind power **will replace** traditional fossil fuels and help reduce carbon emissions."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "and help reduce carbon emissions,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "Renewable energy"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "sources like solar and wind power"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
